text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966. That date is the one the "Paul is dead" hoax gave for his supposed fatal car crash, and he was on holiday with Jane Asher in Africa and France around then. I did not re-check the sources in this turn, and they disagree on a minor accident near that time, so any real incident that day is unverified.

CONFIDENCE: 75
